scripts.title: simple fly (open source)
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local flying = false
local speed = 60
local bodyVelocity
local bodyGyro
local flyConnection

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FlyGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 50)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -25)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.TextSize = 20
button.Text = "Fly: OFF"
button.Active = true
button.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
corner.Parent = button

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = button.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then return end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		button.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

local function stopFlying()
	flying = false
	button.Text = "Fly: OFF"
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)

	if flyConnection then
		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil
	end

	if bodyVelocity then
		bodyVelocity:Destroy()
		bodyVelocity = nil
	end

	if bodyGyro then
		bodyGyro:Destroy()
		bodyGyro = nil
	end
end

local function startFlying()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	flying = true
	button.Text = "Fly: ON"
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 85)

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	bodyGyro.P = 9000
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not flying or not root.Parent then
			stopFlying()
			return
		end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local direction = Vector3.zero

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
			direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
			direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
			direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
			direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
			direction += Vector3.yAxis
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
			direction -= Vector3.yAxis
		end

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
			direction = direction.Unit * speed
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
	end)
end

local function toggleFly()
	if flying then
		stopFlying()
	else
		startFlying()
	end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
		toggleFly()
	end
end)

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	stopFlying()
end)

• Groupbox (Left & Right) — Section containers for organizing controls.
• DependencyBox & DependencyGroupbox — Conditional sections that show or hide based on user settings.
• Tabbox — Nested tab containers inside group boxes.
• WarningBox / ErrorBox — Notification banners embedded inside tabs.
• Dialogs — Modal popups featuring custom buttons (Primary, Secondary, Destructive, Ghost).

2. Interactive Controls & Inputs
• Labels (Text & RichText) — Standard text displays and formatted text elements.
• Button & Sub-Button — Trigger buttons, multi-buttons, and keybound buttons.
• Toggle & Checkbox — On/off switches and selective checkboxes.
• Input (Standard & Numeric) — Text input fields with clear-on-focus, character limits, and numeric filters.
• Slider — Value range bars (standard, compact, custom format).
• Dropdown — Selection menus (single-select, multi-select, searchable, dictionary-based, and player selector).
• KeyPicker / Keybind — Custom key assignment pickers with mode selection (Hold, Toggle, Always).

3. Utility & Overlay Features
• Draggable Watermark — Floating screen label showing real-time FPS and Ping.
• Floating Draggable Button — Interactive floating UI button.
• Draggable Stats Panel — Custom user interface overlay box.
• Custom Cursor System — Reticle/crosshair customizer with color, icon, and size controls.

4. Menu Structure & Tab Names
• Key System — Access validation page.
• Main — Core script controls and audio settings.
• Elements Showcase — Demonstration page for all UI components.
• Tab Manager — Settings for warning banners and dynamic tabs.
• Dynamic Tab — Test tab for runtime modifications (name, icon, order).
• Dialogs — Tester for modal dialog windows.
• Draggables — Management panel for floating/draggable UI elements.
• Utility — Cursor customization, DPI scaling, notification position, and script unloading.
• UI Settings — Theme Manager, Save Manager (configs), and corner radius sliders.

scripts.title: Happymod (Official)
scripts.script:
-- HAPPYMOD (ORIGINAL.1.0)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- UI Base
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "HAPPYMOD_UI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Frame Principal (Verde Escuro)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 320)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.3, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 35, 15)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true -- GUI Arrastável
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
Corner.Parent = MainFrame

-- Título
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Name = "Title"
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "HAPPYMOD (ORIGINAL.1.0)"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 205, 50)
Title.TextSize = 16
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.Parent = MainFrame

-- Scrolling Frame (Barra de Scroll)
local Scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
Scroll.Name = "FunctionsScroll"
Scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -50)
Scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
Scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
Scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
Scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 205, 50)
Scroll.Parent = MainFrame

local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Parent = Scroll
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- Estados das Funções
local States = {
    Fly = false,
    NoClip = false,
    AntiBan = false,
    XRay = false,
    GodMode = false,
    InfJump = false
}

-- Conexões de Loops
local Connections = {}

-- Função Auxiliar para Criar Botões
local function CreateButton(name, text, onClick)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Name = name
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 35)
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 60, 25)
    Btn.Text = text .. ": OFF"
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 205, 50) -- Verde Claro
    Btn.TextSize = 14
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    Btn.Parent = Scroll

    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    BtnCorner.Parent = Btn

    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local newState = onClick(Btn)
        if newState then
            Btn.Text = text .. ": ON"
            Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) -- Vermelho quando ligado
        else
            Btn.Text = text .. ": OFF"
            Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 205, 50) -- Verde Claro quando desligado
        end
    end)
end

-- 1. FLY (Sobe sem parar até desativar)
CreateButton("FlyBtn", "FLY", function()
    States.Fly = not States.Fly
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    
    if States.Fly then
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity") or Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0) -- Velocidade para subir continuamente
            bv.Parent = hrp

            Connections.Fly = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity") then
                    hrp.FlyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
                end
            end)
        end
    else
        if Connections.Fly then Connections.Fly:Disconnect() end
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local bv = char.HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
            if bv then bv:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    return States.Fly
end)

-- 2. NOCLIP
CreateButton("NoClipBtn", "NOCLIP", function()
    States.NoClip = not States.NoClip
    if States.NoClip then
        Connections.NoClip = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if LocalPlayer.Character then
                for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if Connections.NoClip then Connections.NoClip:Disconnect() end
    end
    return States.NoClip
end)

-- 3. ANT-BAN
CreateButton("AntiBanBtn", "ANT-BAN", function()
    States.AntiBan = not States.AntiBan
    return States.AntiBan
end)

-- 4. X-RAY
CreateButton("XRayBtn", "X-RAY", function()
    States.XRay = not States.XRay
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then
            if States.XRay then
                if not obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalTransparency") then
                    local val = Instance.new("NumberValue")
                    val.Name = "OriginalTransparency"
                    val.Value = obj.Transparency
                    val.Parent = obj
                end
                obj.Transparency = 0.5
            else
                if obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalTransparency") then
                    obj.Transparency = obj.OriginalTransparency.Value
                    obj.OriginalTransparency:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return States.XRay
end)

-- 5. GOOD MODE (Velocidade 100, Gravidade da Lua, NoClip, InfJump)
CreateButton("GodModeBtn", "GOOD MODE", function()
    States.GodMode = not States.GodMode
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if States.GodMode then
        workspace.Gravity = 50 -- Gravidade estilo Lua
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100
        end
        Connections.GodModeNoClip = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if LocalPlayer.Character then
                for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        workspace.Gravity = 196.2 -- Gravidade Padrão
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        end
        if Connections.GodModeNoClip then Connections.GodModeNoClip:Disconnect() end
    end
    return States.GodMode
end)

-- 6. INFINITE JUMP
CreateButton("InfJumpBtn", "Infinite jump", function()
    States.InfJump = not States.InfJump
    return States.InfJump
end)

-- Conexão global para o Infinite Jump e God Mode Jump
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if States.InfJump or States.GodMode then
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)

-- Atualiza a altura do Scroll dinamicamente
Scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10)
